After Hours

Murder Mystery Halloween Edition

What’s on

Sat 31 Oct | 7pm-10pm
Tickets: £30 (Adults), £27 (Concession)
Admiral's House, Old Royal Naval College, London SE10 9NN

Book now Plan A Visit

A haunting Halloween murder mystery in Admiral’s House. 

Step into a world of shadows, secrets, and suspense this Halloween, with a thrilling, after-hours murder mystery experience, set within the historic walls of Admiral’s House.

As darkness falls, assemble your team of detectives to explore our historic buildings under the cover of night. You’ll need to hunt for hidden clues and interrogate enigmatic, spine-chilling suspects to piece together the puzzle before the witching hour.

With 90 minutes to investigate, interrogate, and deduce, will your team crack the case, or will the culprit slip away into the night?

Please note: Recommended age 16 and above. 

About the venue

Admiral’s House is the oldest building of the Old Royal Naval College site, originally commissioned by King Charles II to be his King’s House in 1660. In 1745 the rooms became the official residence of the Governor of Greenwich Hospital. It then became known as Admiral’s House, as the Governor was almost always an Admiral.
